hit_sequence_order: impact frame of the attack effect lands

hit_stop.what: freeze ALL battle animation (effects, idles, bobbing). Audio keeps playing; the hit SFX starts at freeze start.
hit_stop.note: critical = 90 ms (our choice; playbook only defines 60 ms)

hit_flash.how: draw the target as a solid fcf6e8 silhouette (provided per creature: creatures/<c>/<c>_<view>_flash) on the white frames. First white frame starts with hit_stop.
hit_flash.reduced_motion: one frame of 50% Bayer white (bayer_fade of the silhouette at t=0.5) for 33 ms

shake.applies_to: world layer (background, platforms, both creatures); HUD/HP boxes stay still for readability

strong_hit.when: the move is strong against the target (type advantage)

shake.decay: roughly linear: amplitude x (1 - step/steps), sign alternates; table above is authoritative (pixel-integer, native 320x240)

hp_drain.tick_sfx: every 3 bar px (bar is 102 px wide)

drop.clip: rows below the original foot line are hidden (sinks into the platform)

faint.sfx: cry pitched down at flicker start, thud at drop end
faint.reduced_motion: play flicker, skip drop; fade frames still play

overuse.trigger: energy overuse event (any time the crystal is pushed past its limit)

wild_leaf.note: Wild encounter in grass: leaf wipe left->right.
wild_leaf.after: hold last frame 100 ms, then cut to the battle scene and reveal with the reverse of reduced_motion_fade (4x75 ms)
wild_leaf.draw: screen-space UI layer, UNGRADED (do not apply the time-of-day grade; it is a full-screen wipe, not a world object)
wild_leaf.tod_note: built to still read if an engine grades it: near-black fills + rims/detail from the 8 night-lit colours fcd668, e8ce92, ecdec4, f8eabe, 603096, 8a4ace, b076ec, d6acff
